meta.dataset: ESTA (Esports Trajectories & Actions), github.com/pnxenopoulos/esta, CC BY-SA 4.0
meta.period: Jan 2021 – May 2022 (CS:GO, MR15, top HLTV-listed online and LAN events)
meta.units: distances in metres at 1 world unit = 0.0254 m (1 inch); game map-% = 51 u
meta.frames: 2 Hz player snapshots (0.5 s), so sight timings carry ±0.5 s resolution
